tools.name: list_accessible_profiles

parameters.description: 1-based page number for paginated results. Defaults to 1.

parameters.name: setActive
parameters.description: If true, persist the single resolved profile as the active profile for this conversation. Ignored unless exactly one profile matches.

parameters.name: workspaceUuid
parameters.description: Optional workspace UUID to limit discovery to one workspace.

tools.name: set_active_profile

parameters.name: username

parameters.name: workspaceUuid
parameters.description: Optional workspace UUID to narrow discovery before resolving the target profile.

tools.description: Retrieve a Linktree profile's social icon links and their display order. If the caller has multiple accessible profiles and no active profile is set, this returns a PROFILE_REQUIRED response with candidates. Call `set_active_profile` once, or pass `username`/`profileUrl`.

parameters.name: profileUrl
parameters.description: Optional Linktree profile URL to target, such as https://linktr.ee/example. Preferred over free-text query for multi-profile users.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional search query for discovery or disambiguation. Matches username, display name, or real name.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Optional Linktree username to target, with or without a leading @. Preferred selector for multi-profile users.

parameters.name: workspaceUuid
parameters.description: Optional workspace UUID to narrow discovery before resolving the target profile.

tools.name: upsert_social_link
tools.summary: Create or update a social icon link on a Linktree profile for a supported platform.
tools.description: Create or update a social icon link on a Linktree profile for a supported platform. If the caller has multiple accessible profiles and no active profile is set, this returns a PROFILE_REQUIRED response with candidates. Call `set_active_profile` once, or pass `username`/`profileUrl`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The social platform type, for example INSTAGRAM or YOUTUBE.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The destination URL or platform value for the social icon.

parameters.name: active
parameters.description: Whether the social icon should be active. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: profileUrl
parameters.description: Optional Linktree profile URL to target, such as https://linktr.ee/example. Preferred over free-text query for multi-profile users.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional search query for discovery or disambiguation. Matches username, display name, or real name.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Optional Linktree username to target, with or without a leading @. Preferred selector for multi-profile users.

parameters.name: workspaceUuid
parameters.description: Optional workspace UUID to narrow discovery before resolving the target profile.

tools.name: reorder_social_links
tools.summary: Move a social icon link to a new position on a Linktree profile.
tools.description: Move a social icon link to a new position on a Linktree profile. Provide exactly one of to, up, or down. If the caller has multiple accessible profiles and no active profile is set, this returns a PROFILE_REQUIRED response with candidates. Call `set_active_profile` once, or pass `username`/`profileUrl`.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: The social platform type to move.

parameters.name: down
parameters.description: Move the social icon down by N positions.

parameters.name: profileUrl
parameters.description: Optional Linktree profile URL to target, such as https://linktr.ee/example. Preferred over free-text query for multi-profile users.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Optional search query for discovery or disambiguation. Matches username, display name, or real name.

parameters.name: to
parameters.description: Move the social icon to an absolute position.

parameters.name: up
parameters.description: Move the social icon up by N positions.

parameters.name: username
parameters.description: Optional Linktree username to target, with or without a leading @. Preferred selector for multi-profile users.

parameters.name: workspaceUuid
parameters.description: Optional workspace UUID to narrow discovery before resolving the target profile.

parameters.description: Optional search query for discovery or disambiguation. Matches username, display name, or real name.

errorContract.envelope: Errors are returned as an MCP tool result with `isError: true` and a single text content block containing JSON: `{ "error": "<CODE>", "message": "<human-readable>" }`. Some codes carry extra fields (e.g. PROFILE_REQUIRED adds `candidates` and `nextAction`).

codes.description: The caller has multiple accessible profiles (or none selected) and must choose one. The envelope includes `candidates` and a `nextAction`.
A referenced resource (link, collection, integration, account) does not exist.
A parameter was missing, empty, or invalid for the requested operation.
The request is missing required identity/authorization headers or the token cannot act on the target.
The caller exceeded the public MCP rate limit. Retry after backing off.
The tool or requested option requires a paid Linktree plan.
A downstream Linktree service returned an error while handling the request.
An unclassified error occurred. Safe to retry once; report if it persists.

example.message: Multiple accessible Linktree profiles are available. Call set_active_profile with a username to choose one for this conversation, or pass username/profileUrl on this call.

nextAction.hint: Call set_active_profile with { username } to stick this profile for the rest of the conversation, or pass username/profileUrl on each call.
